title: Multi-Tenant GPU Fractional Sharing & Hardware Isolation Selection: OS Time-Slicing vs. CUDA MPS vs. NVIDIA Hardware MIG vs. CUDA Green Contexts / Multi-LoRA

official_references: NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) User Guide: https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/mig-user-guide/index.html (Hardware partitioning of SMs, memory controllers, L2 cache crossbar, and error isolation)
NVIDIA Multi-Process Service (MPS) Docs: https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/mps/index.html (Shared GPU virtual address space and fatal fault domain across MPS clients)
NVIDIA CUDA 12.4+ Driver API Green Contexts: https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-driver-api/group__CUDA__GREEN__CONTEXTS.html (Dynamic SM resource partitioning via cudaDevResourceTypeSm)
S-LoRA / Punica Segmented Gather-Scatter Multi-LoRA Serving (SGLang / vLLM production multi-adapter batching)

baseline_parameters.gpu_sku: NVIDIA H100 SXM 80GB (132 SMs, 3,350 GB/s HBM3, up to 7 MIG instances)

dedicated_full_gpu_baseline.label: Baseline: 1 Dedicated Full GPU per Tenant (7 × H100 80GB)

tier1_os_k8s_time_slicing.label: Tier 1: OS / Kubernetes Device-Plugin Time-Slicing (7 Pods on 1 × H100)
tier1_os_k8s_time_slicing.api_semantics_note: Time-slicing multiplexes the entire GPU via temporal context switching without SM or HBM memory protection.

tier2_cuda_mps_spatial_sharing.label: Tier 2: CUDA MPS (Multi-Process Service — Concurrent SM Sharing on 1 × H100)
tier2_cuda_mps_spatial_sharing.api_semantics_note: Per official NVIDIA MPS docs, all clients share one GPU virtual address space and fatal error domain: an unrecoverable GPU fault (Xid 31 / illegal address) in one client terminates all active MPS clients.

tier3_nvidia_hardware_mig.label: Tier 3: NVIDIA Hardware MIG (7 × 1g.10gb / Mixed Silicon Partitions on 1 × H100)
tier3_nvidia_hardware_mig.api_semantics_note: Hardware MIG physically partitions SMs, HBM memory controllers, L2 cache banks, and page tables (0% cross-instance fault propagation), but slices are static and cannot borrow idle SMs across MIG boundaries.

tier4_green_ctx_and_multi_lora.label: Tier 4: CUDA 12.4+ Green Contexts (Intra-Process SM Split) + Punica/S-LoRA Multi-LoRA Serving
tier4_green_ctx_and_multi_lora.green_ctx_sm_split: 108 SMs Prefill/Compute + 24 SMs Decode/Comm (132 SMs total on H100)
tier4_green_ctx_and_multi_lora.api_semantics_note: CUDA 12.4+ Green Contexts (cudaGreenCtxCreate / cudaDevResourceTypeSm) partition SMs inside one process/address space without GPU reset, eliminating Prefill-vs-Decode SM starvation while sharing unified HBM; Multi-LoRA serves N adapters inside one trusted inference engine.
